last_cycle_outcome: H52 KEEP ON MOUSE, REFUSED ON CONNECTOME BY THE AUDITOR. New move class: sequential exact-gain pair relocation (stage 5). Take a backward edge, extract BOTH endpoints, re-insert them adjacent at the best split inside the interval; exact by the contiguous-block lemma, O(d(u)+d(v)) per candidate. The champion is blind to it by construction - 989 of 3,498 positive-gain pairs on its own connectome order have ZERO solo gain at both endpoints. THE WORD 'SEQUENTIAL' IS THE RESULT: the identical class applied as a disjoint batch gives +0.00193 pp (H45), applied one move at a time it gives +0.02233 pp - 11.6x. Diagnosed in H50: a pair move's interval averages ~20,536 positions, so disjoint intervals barely fit on a 136,648-position line and the batched form discarded 99.9% of what it found (4,018,567 candidates, 4,193 applied). This is an ARCHITECTURAL finding: every refiner in this campaign batches disjoint moves, which is optimal for one-position windows and catastrophic for wide ones. H38 confirms the other side - for single-node moves, batched Jacobi BEATS block-sequential at every K. CONFIRM: connectome 84.17502222088821 (5/5, std 0, +0.02093 pp), mouse 93.10282596057698 (20/20, std 0, +0.01995 pp -> PROMOTED), microns bit-identical to H42 (0 of 67,534 positions differ; stage 5 DISABLED there because its screen run took 3435.5 s against a 3450 s deadline - P07 as a hard budget, not a defect). CONNECTOME WAS REFUSED: audit --gate promotion FAILS protocol_ci, threshold 0.02343 pp at n=5 vs delta 0.02093. Even fully converged the class gives +0.02233 pp, so NO configuration passes. Raising n to 7 would have passed it by shrinking an artificial SE on a std=0 pipeline; that was refused and filed as P09 for the operator. ALSO THIS SESSION: six axes closed with artifacts (epochs on both primaries, initial order, stage-3 caps, segment moves, coarse block permutation at exactly zero, batched pair relocation); the refinement stack is NOT monotone in input quality (three independent measurements); L01 ran for the first time and corrected the mission target's attribution (84.6147 is NOT Vahidi 2025's 84.6125; the actual source is unretrieved) and narrowed M4, which had killed H22 before building on a misread statistic.
current_item_note: DIVERGENT MODE ENTERED 2026-08-16. consecutive_kills = 5 since the H44 score move (H41, H48/H49, H43, H46, H38 - every one a SCIENCE item, every one measured with an artifact). campaign.yaml's escalation rule forces a structurally different approach and forbids an infrastructure item from satisfying it. history.note: Port MacBook/MPS -> Windows/RTX 4060 (CUDA). 12 runs, 3 seeds x (H35 connectome, H30 microns, H30 mouse, H35 mouse). All champions re-measured; every seed bit-identical (sigma = 0). Also fixed: CRLF broke the frozen manifest; the guard hook was inert on Windows; audit.py pooled runs across devices and called the frozen scorer with the wrong signature; the driver watchdog could not kill native Windows processes.

Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). So the screen now runs 1 seed on the primaries for deterministic variants: 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. Mouse stays at 3 as a falsifying tripwire and confirm_seeds is unchanged, so no promotion-path CI is ever computed on a 1-seed pool. NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

NEW CHAMPION x3, second score move of the campaign, from two constants. Resumed cycle 4's detached prototype (it survived the session boundary - the post-cycle-#1 detach discipline working as designed). Prototype answered both open questions: (Q2 allocation) at a matched 1200 s connectome budget, sweeps=8/4/2 give 84.1333/84.1353/84.1588, so the cheap inner sift is worth +0.0255 pp on the SAME seconds; (Q1 sizing) the curve saturates at ~143 cycles and past 77 the remaining +0.0047 pp is below the 0.012 pp minimum effect size, which is why 77 ships. Mouse measured over a 9-point grid: every config returns exactly 92.917014, so it is saturated and cannot distinguish allocations. Confirm 5/5/20, all bit-identical; PROTOCOL CI lo +0.0335 (connectome), +0.0063 (microns), -0.1626 (mouse, PASSES non-inferiority). audit exit 0 with 6 explained warnings. THREE THINGS FOR THE NEXT CYCLE. (1) P05 is now BLOCKING (priority 0): microns crosses the 3400 s warn band on every run and has 182 s of margin left, so the next variant that adds stage-4 work on microns overruns the 3600 s cap on a loaded machine - and the guard must degrade DETERMINISTICALLY (a time-sized cycle count would break the bit-reproducibility sota.json and the P02 1-seed screen rest on). (2) P04 is narrower than filed: the mouse gate PASSED here purely because the comparator pool was 20 seeds not 3 (protocol_se ~ sqrt(2/n_c)); re-scope it to 'require a 20-seed mouse comparator' rather than re-specifying the statistic. (3) New item P06: results/*.json discards history.attrs (so per-stage timings are unauditable - H42's runtime attribution is an INFERENCE, not a measurement), and sweep.sh --role confirm ignores campaign.yaml confirm_seeds and silently defaults to 3 seeds. Also: the critic subagent was NOT run this cycle (time), the checklist was self-administered - the one procedural shortfall, recorded in log.md.

The run-level wall-clock guard is built, armed by default and verified on 2 of 3 datasets. No algorithm changed; sota.json untouched. The defect was wider than filed: every stage already honoured a budget and nothing ever passed one, so time_limit=None made every check a dead branch and a run had NO upper bound. eval/runtime_guard.py resolves 3600-150 = 3450 s when the caller gives none; reserve_s measured in proto_P05.json (36.0/20.5/0.1 s of prologue+epilogue outside the deadline) plus abort granularity, both margins pinned by tests/test_runtime_guard.py. ABORT at a stage boundary, never a sizing rule, so the H42 determinism constraint holds. Fires correctly (mouse at --time-limit 3: rocket 2159/5000, sift 2/40, stage4 1/32, degraded=true - and it scored HIGHER than the champion, which is why the flag is structural and not a score comparison). Does not fire: connectome s42 bit-identical to the stored confirm vector (0/136,648 differing, sha b56aa222bedfe958), mouse 3/3 at 92.917014. audit.py gained a runtime_guard check (FAIL truncated / WARN pre-P05) and still exits 0 on the champion evidence. P06(a) closed with it - results/*.json now persist history.attrs as variant_attrs, without which 'did the guard truncate this run?' is unanswerable; per-stage timings are measurements from here (connectome stage 3 = 134.4 s, stage 4 = 697.3 s). UNFINISHED: the microns leg. Launched detached, killed 13 min in by an external actor which appended 'OPERATOR ABORT ... killed by user request' to autoresearch/.sweep/log; no process, no result, running-marker removed without done. Not restarted - relaunching a ~57 min GPU job somebody just killed on a machine they are using is not an unattended cycle's call. NEW FINDING -> P07 (priority 0): the connectome verification was bit-identical in RESULT but took 1483.9 s vs cycle 5's 1226.5-1238.3 s (spread 1.0%), i.e. this machine is ~20% slower under ordinary desktop load; scaled to microns that is ~4100 s against the 3600 s cap, so the CHAMPION's microns configuration does not fit the runtime invariant on a working laptop. consecutive_kills left at 0 deliberately: P05 is not a falsified hypothesis, and the counter exists to detect stalled SCORE hunting.

_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
